description:
Message your coding agents like teammates.

Hypurr turns the coding agents on your computer — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, OpenCode, Grok Build, Gemini, GitHub Copilot and dozens more — into persistent bots you delegate to from your iPhone. Pick who, say what, put the phone away.

BOTS, NOT SESSIONS
Give each bot a name, a character, standing instructions, an agent and a project folder. Each bot is one ongoing conversation, so there's no hunting for the right session or setting up an environment every time — just open the chat and type.

APPROVE FROM ANYWHERE
When an agent wants to run a command or change files, an approval card arrives in the chat: Allow once, Always allow or Deny. You get a notification only when a bot needs you or finishes.

A CALM CHAT
The conversation shows your messages and each final reply. Every command, file change, plan and thought is one tap away in Full conversation. While a bot works, you see what it's doing right now.

USAGE AT A GLANCE
See your Claude and Codex subscription limits in the app, in widgets and on the Lock Screen. Follow a working bot in a Live Activity and the Dynamic Island.

YOUR COMPUTER, YOUR CODE
Agents run on your Mac or Linux machine with your own logins. Away from home, the free built-in relay connects your phone end-to-end encrypted, so it only ever forwards ciphertext; on the same Wi-Fi or Tailscale the phone connects directly. Your code and conversations stay on your computer.

GET STARTED
Install Hypurr on your Mac (brew install --cask Ragul84/hypurr/hypurr) or the host on Linux, then scan the pairing code. Open source: github.com/Ragul84/Hypurr
promotionalText: Delegate to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more from your iPhone. Each agent is a bot you message; approve actions and get notified when it's done.
whatsNew: Hypurr 2.2: persistent bots for every coding agent on your computer, group chats and threads, approvals from your phone, remote screen, voice calls, a native Mac window and a Linux app.
